reason: I do 1-6 homes a year and the architect already gives my clients renderings. I'd have to get a homeowner to agree to a line item for it, and most won't pay extra for something they think the architect covers.
objection: I bill cost-plus and only add a line if the homeowner says yes. For $1,500 on top of what the architect already provides, I'm the one stuck eating it when the client says no.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it over lunch on one of my real plans, and a couple of Parade homeowners telling me it cut change orders enough that they'd happily pay for it. Then it's an easy line item to sell.
